title: Version delivery provenance at the real email queue and provider boundaries
detail: Inventory real app/lib email helper, direct campaign queue, Resend and Supabase-auth send boundaries with scripts/email-sender-inventory.mjs. Add v1 internal context with recipient/logical key, Space scope, explicit purpose/topic, identity revision and source reference; queue preserves it, provider strips it, malformed claimed context rejects before queue/provider and legacy mail continues without invented purpose. Context conveys provenance, never grants authorization: identity policy, dispatch-time reads, durable intent/attempt ledger, provider idempotency and status projections are dependent packets, not shipped by this row. Supabase-owned account authentication mail remains separately inventoried. CLOSED 2026-10-08 after an in-process consequence probe evaluates the shipped parser, enqueue and provider boundary with external transports replaced; the full sender inventory is checked separately by its CLI and test; local source only, no live send or production observation.
